r: What food do you have available for trade?
Is the back room available for rent?

prim_cook_2.m: Food? No, sorry. I don't have anything to trade.

prim_cook_3.m: Rent? Hmm. No, not at the moment.

prim_cook_41.m: It is still rented out to Arghest. He would not be very happy if I rented it out to someone else when he expects to use it.

prim_cook_5.m: Now that you mention it, he hasn't been around here for quite some time. Maybe you could go talk to him and see if he still wants to rent it?
r: OK, I will go talk to him.
Sure. Any idea where he might be?

prim_cook_6.m: I don't know where he is now, but I do know that he used to be part of the mining effort in our mine to the southwest.
r: Thanks. I will go look for him.
I will go look for him right away.

prim_cook_return_1.m: Thank you for your help earlier. I hope the back room is comfortable enough.

r: [Lie] Yes, he told me that I could rest in the back room if I want to.
Yes, he gave me permission to use the back room whenever I wish.

prim_cook_return_3.m: Return to me once you know if he is still interested in renting the back room or not.
r: Any idea where he might be?

prim_cook_return_4.m: Did he really say that? Somehow I doubt that. It doesn't sound like him.

prim_cook_return_5.m: You will have to do something more to convince me.

prim_cook_return_6.m: Really, he did? Well then, go ahead. I'm just glad the back room is being used.

prim_cook_return_7.m: You are welcome to rest in the back room any time you want. Please let me know if there is anything I can do to help.

prim_innquest.10: I talked to the cook in Prim, at the base of Blackwater mountain. There is a back room available for rent, but it is currently rented out to Arghest. I should go talk to Arghest to see whether he still wants to rent the room. The cook pointed me towards the southwest of Prim.
prim_innquest.20: I talked to Arghest about the back room at the inn. He is still interested in having it as an option to rest at. But he told me he could probably be persuaded to let me use it if I compensate him sufficiently.
prim_innquest.30: Arghest wants me to bring him 5 bottles of milk. I can probably find some milk in any of the larger villages.
prim_innquest.40: I have brought the milk to Arghest. He agreed to let me use the back room at the Prim inn. I should be able to rest there now. I should go talk to the cook at the inn.
prim_innquest.50: I have explained to the cook that I have permission by Arghest to use the back room.
